1. Origin = tilt axis at the head's center plane (X0). Y- = front (camera side).
2. Printed holes come out ~0.2 small: test-print one hole first.
3. Print back-down (open back on the bed). Stub axle prints sideways: ok, or glue in an 8 mm pin.
